decision_140: Owner decision 140 (2026-09-26): the np1 cache-off test is authorised as a CHEAP TEST, but ADOPTION of any geometry is decided on THROUGHPUT, because future rounds need massive sampling. This cell decides a DETERMINISM question and INFORMS a THROUGHPUT one; the coordinator will not adopt np1 for sampling-heavy work on determinism alone. The read therefore reports, beside per-row byte identity, contacts per minute and prompt tokens per second for each pass at the np1 cache-off geometry -- from the sealed dispatch window (flight-receipts.json run_phases: wall_seconds, contact_window, contact_count) and the sealed generation manifest's cost block (prompt_tokens_total) -- and the same two numbers for the resident np4 geometry from ROLL-2's sealed arm (8,996 contacts, 81,435,827 prompt tokens, 16:00:01Z to 18:22:39Z, 8,558 s: 63.07 contacts per minute, 9,515.8 prompt tokens per second), so the trade is one table.

geometry.one_resident_server_per_geometry: Flying this cell requires the coordinator to STOP the resident np4 session serving-slurp-native-candidate-five-train-a-np4-v1 and START serving-slurp-native-det-np1-nocache-v1 from q4km-mmproj-free-slurp-native-bounded-perception-proof-np1-nocache-ctx24k-max512-v1 (scripts/flights/det/serving_task_entry_det.sh); core.session.serving refuses two resident sessions and a listening port, and a flight attaches only to a session whose identity matches flag by flag. That is why this cell queues behind the CONV probe now in the air and why the np4 session is restored afterwards.

hypothesis.if_all_50_repeat: the between-flight offset is an artefact of batch composition and cache state; the cross-flight bar (2.5-3.0 pp) would collapse toward the within-flight 0.735 pp or lower at this geometry, at a throughput cost decision 140 weighs separately; the coordinator scales the probe to 200 rows (a separate registration) for the floor re-estimate
hypothesis.if_not_all_50_repeat: single-slot, cache-off serving does not make the flight reproducible: the offset is intrinsic to the model's numerics on this hardware and the programme stops hoping for a cheaper instrument along this axis
hypothesis.question: Is the programme's between-flight measurement floor an engineering artefact of the serving geometry -- greedy decoding under four-slot continuous batching with a prompt cache and a quantised KV cache -- or a property of the model's numerics on this hardware?

prohibitions: No effectiveness, superiority, generalisation, admission or floor-re-estimate claim from this cell: 50 rows decide only whether the 200-row re-estimate is worth flying.
No adoption of the np1 geometry for sampling-heavy work on determinism alone (decision 140): adoption is decided on throughput.
No test-split, Fold B or DEV contact or read.
No change to any knob of the locked plan; the geometry is the one variable and it is already fixed here.
No flight before root mints the decision receipt, countersigns the five rows, flips both passes, and swaps the resident session; the resident np4 session is never touched by the registration agent.

SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-DET-NP1-FOLD-A-50-A-V1.note: The cell measures REPRODUCIBILITY -- per-row byte identity of the delivered answer across two request-identical passes on a single-slot, prompt-cache-off serving geometry, and the SLU/intent difference of the pair -- and makes NO effectiveness claim. Its 50 rows are under the measurement instrument's MIN_BENEFIT_ROWS, so under rule 5 this is a form proof by size; claims_benefit is false and expected_effect_pp is 0.0 because the cell registers no effect to look for: the passes are the same request and any difference between them is the instrument, not a mechanism. It is NOT an admission request: no admission mode is declared and no harm margin is claimed. A 50-row cell cannot support a floor re-estimate; it decides only whether the 200-row re-estimate is worth flying, and (decision 140) it decides a determinism question while merely informing a throughput one.
SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-DET-NP1-FOLD-A-50-A-V1.primary_metric: per-row byte identity of the delivered answer between pass A and pass B (the count of identical rows out of 50), with the pair's pooled SLU-F1 and intent difference reported as descriptive numbers and, under decision 140, contacts per minute and prompt tokens per second per pass beside ROLL-2's np4 numbers
